title: IT Dialer Technician
description:
**Company:** Proclivity Digitech Pvt. Ltd.  
**Location:** Kolkata, Sector V  
**Job Type:** Full-Time | In-Office  
**Experience:** 2–4 Years

Job Summary

Proclivity Digitech Pvt. Ltd. is looking for an experienced **IT Dialer Technician** to manage, monitor, and troubleshoot the company's **dialer, VoIP, telephony, and calling infrastructure** supporting our Website Sales, BPO, and ELD operations.

The candidate should have hands-on experience with **ViciDial, VoIP, SIP, Linux/Windows servers, networking, and call-centre technology** and should be capable of quickly resolving technical issues affecting calling operations.

Key Responsibilities

* Install, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot **ViciDial and other dialer systems**.
* Monitor dialer performance, call connectivity, agent login, campaigns, and calling issues.
* Troubleshoot **VoIP, SIP, DID, IP phones, softphones, extensions, and call routing**.
* Manage and troubleshoot **Linux and Windows Server environments**.
* Monitor server performance, disk space, services, logs, and system availability.
* Configure and troubleshoot **SIP trunks, gateways, extensions, and VoIP accounts**.
* Resolve issues related to **call drops, one-way audio, no audio, registration failures, latency, and call quality**.
* Manage dialer campaigns, user accounts, agent extensions, call queues, and basic dialer configurations.
* Monitor internet connectivity and network performance affecting voice operations.
* Troubleshoot **LAN, WAN, routers, switches, DNS, DHCP, and basic firewall issues**.
* Coordinate with VoIP providers, telecom vendors, ISPs, and external technical teams.
* Maintain system backups and assist with server recovery when required.
* Monitor dialer uptime and ensure minimum disruption to sales and customer-support operations.
* Provide technical support to **Website Sales, ELD Sales, ELD Customer Support, and other voice-process teams**.
* Maintain documentation of technical issues, configurations, troubleshooting steps, and resolutions.
* Perform preventive maintenance and recommend improvements to the dialer and VoIP infrastructure.

Required Technical Skills

* Hands-on experience with **ViciDial**.
* Strong understanding of **VoIP and SIP technology**.
* Knowledge of **Linux Server and Windows Server**.
* Understanding of **Asterisk** will be an advantage.
* Knowledge of **SIP Trunk, DID, extensions, IP phones, and softphones**.
* Good understanding of networking: **TCP/IP, LAN, WAN, DNS, DHCP, routers, and switches**.
* Basic knowledge of firewall and port configuration.
* Understanding of call-centre/dialer operations.
* Ability to troubleshoot voice quality and connectivity problems.
* Good knowledge of **MS Excel** for basic reports and operational tracking.

Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate should be:

* **Hands-on and technically strong**
* Quick at diagnosing and resolving dialer issues
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced BPO environment
* Able to handle critical technical issues under pressure
* Strong in troubleshooting and problem-solving
* Proactive in monitoring systems and preventing downtime
* Good at coordinating with vendors and internal teams
* Available to support business-critical systems when required

Preferred Experience

Experience supporting **BPO, international voice processes, Website Sales, ELD/Telematics, VoIP, call-centre dialers, or telecom operations** will be preferred.

Key Performance Areas

**ViciDial | VoIP | SIP | Asterisk | Linux Server | Windows Server | Dialer Monitoring | SIP Trunk | DID | Call Quality | Networking | Server Uptime | Troubleshooting | Vendor Coordination**

**Apply with your updated CV.**

Pay: ₹15,000.00 - ₹25,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Infra Tech Support Practitioner
description:
**Project Role :** Infra Tech Support Practitioner  

**Project Role Description :** Provide L1–L2 technical support for infrastructure, systems, and applications in production and development environments, both remotely and onsite, following defined operating models and processes. Act as the primary interface with users/clients to accurately diagnose issues and deliver effective resolutions across infrastructure, operating systems, networks, and application platforms, ensuring service stability and quality support.
  

**Must have skills :** Ansible on Microsoft Azure  

**Good to have skills :** NA  

Minimum **5** year(s) of experience is required  

**Educational Qualification :** 15 years full time education  

  

Summary:
  

As an Infra Tech Support Practitioner, a typical day involves delivering first and second level technical assistance for infrastructure, systems, and applications across both production and development settings. This role requires working closely with users and clients, either remotely or onsite, to identify and resolve technical issues efficiently. The practitioner follows established operational procedures to maintain service reliability and quality, ensuring smooth functioning of infrastructure components, operating systems, network elements, and application platforms. Collaboration with various teams and adherence to defined processes are key aspects of daily activities, aimed at sustaining optimal service performance and user satisfaction.  

  

Roles \& Responsibilities:
  

* Expected to be an SME, collaborate and manage the team to perform.
* Responsible for team decisions.
* Engage with multiple teams and contribute on key decisions.
* Provide solutions to problems for their immediate team and across multiple teams.
* Coordinate with cross\-functional teams to ensure timely resolution of incidents and service requests.
* Monitor infrastructure health and proactively identify potential issues to minimize downtime.
* Support junior team members by providing guidance and knowledge sharing to enhance team capabilities.


  

Professional \& Technical Skills:
  

* Must To Have Skills: Proficiency in Ansible on Microsoft Azure.
* Experience in automating infrastructure deployment and configuration management using Ansible within cloud environments.
* Strong understanding of Microsoft Azure services and their integration with automation tools.
* Ability to troubleshoot and resolve issues related to infrastructure, operating systems, and network components.
* Familiarity with scripting and automation best practices to improve operational efficiency.
* Capability to work with monitoring tools and interpret system alerts to maintain service stability.


  

Additional Information:
  

* The candidate should have minimum 5 years of experience in Ansible on Microsoft Azure.
* This position is based at our Kolkata office.
* A 15 years full time education is required.

  

15 years full time education
